name: The Nine Pillars
tagline: The interior axis — the direction her devotion points, and why she loves the way she does.
body: Role in Family is the exterior axis: three evocative titles, how the family reads her. Personal Vibe is the interior axis: a primary Pillar with a flavour, optionally a secondary. Hybrids are permitted. Pillars are subject to the Lived Evolution clause — a girl may move between them, and the move is a canon change with an effective arc, not a correction.
rules: NOT THE SAME PILLARS AS PROJECT NEREID’S FIVE. These are the Nine Pillars of Love — the interior devotion axis. See nereid-pillars-five
